newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London fall, weighed down by HSBC.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London fall, weighed down by HSBC.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were broadly lower on Monday as steep falls in shares of heavyweight banking group HSBC Holdings dragged other issues lower, dealers said.
HSBC stock fell HK$3.40 to close at HK$258.60, after shares in British banks tumbled in London, weighed down by profit-taking following recent gains in the sector.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index dropped 113.33 points to close at 15,422.97, after the Hang Seng Index in Hong Kong eased 34.10 points to finish at 15,536.30.
Dealers said property issues also weakened as nervousness in the sector in Hong Kong spilled over into London. Shares in New World Development fell 25 cents to HK47.15.
